_comment_debug_timing: Set true only when diagnosing latency; it adds detailed timing logs.
_comment_stats_json: Set true to emit periodic stats as JSON log lines for later analysis.
_comment_debug_pprof_addr: Optional local pprof listen address for deep profiling, e.g. 127.0.0.1:6060. Leave empty unless actively profiling.
_comment_write_startup_diagnostics: Set true to write one redacted diagnostics zip on startup, then continue running normally.
_comment_diagnostics_output_dir: Directory for startup diagnostics zips. Relative paths are created beside the client binary. Empty uses diagnostics/ beside the binary.
_comment_save_terminal_log: Set true during field tests to keep printing logs in the terminal and also save the same run to a .log file for later debugging. Terminal logs are not redacted; review destination hostnames/IPs and any full direct URLs/tokens before sharing.
_comment_terminal_log_file: Optional log filename/prefix for save_terminal_log. Relative paths are created beside the client binary. Empty auto-creates logs/goose-client-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.log. A custom path still creates a fresh timestamped file every run.
_comment_socks_host: Local SOCKS5 listen host. Use 127.0.0.1 for this device only. If you use 0.0.0.0 for LAN sharing, also set socks_user and socks_pass.
_comment_socks_port: Local SOCKS5 listen port used by your browser, app, or VPN client.
_comment_google_host: Google edge IP/host dialed for Apps Script domain fronting. This is not your VPS. Keep the default unless the startup probe or logs show bad Google routing, then test another 216.239.x.120 address.
_comment_sni: Google SNI names to rotate across. If the startup probe drops one host but keeps another, that is OK; the client will use the healthy hosts.
_comment_fronting_http_version: Fronting HTTP version. auto keeps current HTTP/2-first behavior; h1 can be tested on lossy mobile networks; h2 forces HTTP/2.
_comment_transport_mode: Default is apps_script, the safest fronted mode when direct VPS access is blocked. Set auto only when you intentionally configured direct_stream_urls or relay_urls and want the client to try that direct path.
_comment_direct_stream_urls: Optional direct VPS WebSocket /stream endpoints, e.g. ws://YOUR.VPS.IP:8443/stream. Only used when transport_mode is auto or direct_stream. Use wss:// only behind your own TLS reverse proxy. Leave empty when direct VPS access is blocked or unstable.
_comment_relay_urls: Optional direct VPS POST /tunnel endpoints, e.g. http://YOUR.VPS.IP:8443/tunnel. Only used when transport_mode is auto or direct_post; otherwise leave empty for normal Apps Script/fronting use.
_comment_downstream_replay_mode: Lost-response recovery for Apps Script/direct POST. auto activates only when the server advertises support. It helps videos/downloads survive lost Google/mobile HTTP responses; direct stream is unchanged.
_comment_fresh_start_reset: When true, each client startup asks the VPS to close stale tunnel sessions from the previous run of this same client instance. This makes Ctrl+C then start feel fresh without restarting the VPS process. It cannot reset Google quota.
_comment_client_instance_id: Optional stable label for this device/client, e.g. phone-main. Leave empty and the client creates .goose-client-instance beside this config. Do not reuse the same ID on two devices running at the same time.
_comment_client_instance_id_file: Optional file for the auto-generated client_instance_id. Relative paths are stored beside this config. Leave empty for .goose-client-instance beside this config.
_comment_quota_state_path: Persists only daily quota quarantines so restarting does not keep retrying accounts already known to be quota-dead today. Empty string disables persistence; default is .goose-quota-state.json beside this config.
_comment_script_keys: Apps Script deployment IDs. Add more entries for extra deployments/accounts, e.g. {"id":"AKfycb...","account":"acct-b"}. Deployments with the same account label share one Apps Script quota/idle bucket.
_comment_tunnel_key: 64 hex characters. Must exactly match server_config.json tunnel_key.
_comment_socks_auth: Optional SOCKS5 username/password. Set both fields or leave both empty.
_comment_max_local_sessions: Optional cap on concurrent local SOCKS sessions accepted by the SOCKS listener. 0 means no extra listener cap, but the carrier still has a built-in storm guard (1024 active sessions and 80 new sessions/sec) to protect memory.
_comment_performance_mode: latency is best for browsing, YouTube start speed, Google Play, and chat apps. throughput uses bigger batches for stable bulk downloads but can feel slower on weak mobile links.
_comment_auto_tune: When true, tunes only safe latency windows inside fixed caps. Beginners should leave false until they have logs showing a specific bottleneck.
_comment_coalesce_step_ms: Client upload coalescing delay. 0 is best for low latency; 20-40 can reduce request count at the cost of delay.
_comment_idle_slots_per_bucket: Concurrent idle long-polls per Google account while active. Keep 1 for one deployment per account. Try 2 only when each Google account has 2+ deployments and you want more download push capacity. In a single-bucket pure-download burst the client may temporarily allow 2 idle polls for responsiveness even when this is 1.
_comment_idle_poll_mode: Apps Script quota saver. adaptive is recommended for 24/7 background clients: it stays responsive when active, then reduces idle quota burn. always is fastest while idle; off saves the most quota.
_comment_idle_poll_max_buckets: Max Google account buckets used by idle polls when there are zero active sessions. 2 prevents four-account configs from burning every account while idle.
_comment_workers_per_endpoint: POST poll workers per relay endpoint/deployment. 3 is the low-latency default. Higher values can reduce wait time but burn quota faster and can hit Apps Script simultaneous-execution limits. Changing this requires restarting the client.
_comment_tx_slots_per_bucket: Max concurrent active POSTs per Google account bucket. Default is 3, even if workers_per_endpoint is higher. Lower to 1-2 if one healthy account is being hammered after other accounts hit quota; raise to 4-8 only after logs prove the account handles it.
_comment_poll_idle_sleep_ms: Worker sleep after a no-work poll during active use. Lower is snappier but spins more often.
_comment_poll_timeout_ms: Per relay HTTP request timeout. 300000 means 5 minutes. Apps Script UrlFetch has its own shorter server-side ceiling, so this mostly protects slow fronting/client downloads and direct relay modes.
_comment_endpoint_blacklist_base_ms: Initial retry backoff for a failing relay endpoint.
_comment_endpoint_blacklist_max_ms: Maximum retry backoff for repeatedly failing relay endpoints.
_comment_endpoint_outage_grace_ms: How long to hold active sessions during local/mobile internet outages. 300000 means 5 minutes. Relay-side HTML/404 errors use a shorter internal grace so bad deployments fail faster.
_comment_max_request_bytes_pre_encode: Max plaintext batch size before encryption/base64. Keep at 8 MiB for Apps Script safety.
_comment_tx_buffer_budget_bytes: Global queued upload buffer budget across all local sessions. 64 MiB protects Android/Termux from tab explosions without limiting one normal upload.
_comment_stream_connect_timeout_ms: Direct WebSocket stream connect timeout. Only used when direct_stream_urls is configured.
_comment_stream_ping_interval_ms: Direct stream ping interval. Only used when direct_stream_urls is configured.
_comment_stream_reconnect_backoff_ms: Direct stream reconnect delay after disconnect. Keep low for fast recovery.
